text: The total addressable market for LER exceeds $1 trillion, driven by the great reallocation of capital out of underperforming fixed income into equities and DeFi.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
abstract: Based on available market analyses, the TAM for LER exceeds $1 trillion, because of the "great reallocation" of capital from underperforming fixed-income assets to higher-yielding alternatives like equities and DeFi.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: based on available market analyses as of 2025
